reason: "For new learners the advantage holds" summarizes the advantage without claiming it holds in every dataset.
"Direct L2 loss" is listed separately from the residual variants.
"Helpful for SeerAttention and FlexPrefill-Llama" describes an overall benefit, not improvement at every context length.
"Useful in some FlexPrefill settings" explicitly means at least one setting, not every setting.
"Further demonstrate portability to a specialized medical domain" does not explicitly tie the twelve VLMs to that medical-domain study.
"Across multiple sparse baselines, benchmarks, and LLM backbones" and "consistent gains" assert gains across settings, not merely on average.
"Adding direct supervision of the teacher's top token lowers performance" is unqualified and does not exclude Sampled OPD.
"Across the evaluated settings" asserts multiple settings, although the claim names no additional settings individually.
"Both combinations surpass teacher-only OPD, and Co-RA adds a further" distinguishes the two RA combinations from the Co-RA variants.
